alarms.action: Conveyor motor stops immediately and jam alarm M190 is raised until reset via PB-0002 (X1)
alarms.condition: Entry photo-eye PE-1002 remains blocked for more than 5.0 s while the conveyor is running
alarms.name: Jam alarm

alarms.action: Conveyor motor stops immediately and overload alarm M191 is raised
alarms.name: Motor overload alarm

conflicts.narrative_says: Conveyor stops and jam alarm is raised if entry photo-eye PE-1002 stays blocked for more than 5.0 s while conveyor runs
conflicts.parameter_sheet_says: jam_time = 5.0 s assigned to timer T10
conflicts.program_says: Missing / unprogrammed (timer T10 and photo-eye PE-1002 jam logic are absent; M190 is reset in R2 but never set anywhere in ST10)

interlocks.effect: Conveyor motor M-1001 (Y10) stops immediately and motor overload alarm M191 activates

interlocks.cause: E-stop chain not healthy ES-0001 (X0 low)
interlocks.effect: Conveyor motor M-1001 (Y10) stops immediately via master fault relay M199

interlocks.cause: Entry photo-eye PE-1002 blocked for more than 5.0 s while conveyor is running

steps.entry: Auto mode active (SS-0003 / X2) with no ST10 fault active (E-stop healthy ES-0001 / X0, motor overload healthy MOL-1001 / X13, and no jam alarm M190)
steps.exit: Auto mode switched off, E-stop lost, motor overload tripped, or jam alarm raised
steps.name: Conveyor Run

steps.entry: Pallet arrives against spring stopper at test position and at-stop photo-eye PE-1001 (X10) makes
steps.exit: Release request pulse received from line controller (RQ-1005 / X14 rising edge)
steps.name: Pallet At Stop

steps.entry: Rising edge of release request (RQ-1005 / X14) energises stopper solenoid XY-1004 (Y11)
steps.exit: Release timer T11 reaches 2.0 s, de-energising stopper solenoid XY-1004 (Y11)
steps.name: Stopper Release
